manaNeeded: {1}{G} during each of your turns, plus an additional {1}{G} available during each of your turns for each opponent you have
description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 1 once for each opponent you have.
At the beginning of each end step, Possessed Portal triggers, causing each player to sacrifice a permanent, with you sacrificing an Insect token.
Repeat step 3 during each turn.
Players are unable to draw cards due to Possessed Portal's ability.
